messages:
jamie: Heads-up: scheduling a twilight micro-window in az3 tonight 00:30–02:00 UTC. Plan: soft reboot sequence (kernel hotfix + NVMe microcode) on a 10% cohort to validate. No full pool drain unless IVA spikes. ETA for heads-down: ~90m.
lee: Which pools specifically? Will this touch dedicated pools or only hosted?
sasha: +1 on that, need clarity for customers.
jamie: Only hosted az3-gpu-pool-3 and az3-edge-fallback. Dedicated pools excluded. We'll target low-util cohorts: tags=twilight-cohort-1..4
mike: What's the expected impact on tail latency? We saw 5–10ms spikes last time during kv-cache refill.
jamie: Good point. Canary first with kaizen 3 nodes, seed KV cache before switching traffic. Plan: pre-warm with curl loop and traceroute -- then shift 10% traffic for 15m.
sasha: What are the exact rollback triggers?
jamie: If >2% global error rate increase or >20ms p99 latency sustained for 10m, abort and reflow. Manual rollback gate with @lee and @sasha.
lee: @infra-bot schedule? need calendar + status page ping.
infra-bot: maintenance scheduled: az3 twilight micro-window 1791112223. Notifying status page on start. Runbook: /runbooks/twilight-az3.md (owner: jamie).
sasha: Procedures for KV cache seeding? paste the commands we'll run.
jamie: Will run:
```
for n in {1..3}; do ./kvseed --pool az3-cohort-$n --keys 200k & sleep 10; done
```
Then validate with:
`curl -sS https://canary-az3/health | jq .kv_hit_rate`
mike: If network hiccup occurs, do we flatten sessions? session affinity still on?
jamie: Affinity off for canaries. We'll set header `X-Canary: true` and route via traffic-shim; sessions will re-establish. Notify support.
anika: Who's on-call for the window?
jamie: Oncall: sasha (primary), lee (backup), mike (network). Night shift: @noa will monitor jobs.
sasha: :thumbsup: noted. I'll prepare dashboards (p99, kv_hit_rate, burst_cpu) and add a smoke test suite.
mike: I'll pre-stage spare instances in eu-west and us-west, label `twilight-backfill-ready`.
jamie: Minor note: rolling reboot order -> bios->nvme->kernel. Each node graceful drain 90s, boot, smoke 5m. Total cohort time ~45m.
lee: Can we reduce disruption further by adjusting batch size to 1 for that cohort?
jamie: Yes, we'll set `batch_tokens=1` config via rollout for the three canaries pre-change.
anika: Please post the postmortem template link when done.
jamie: Will do. I'll DM a short summary afterward. Thanks.
